evals.prompt: Add a new persistent plan that depends on .agents/plan/auth.md.
evals.expected_output: Runs the plan-graph check command first, reviews existing candidate plans, classifies the relationship, then adds a new node and dependency only if the work is truly dependent.
assertions: Checks the existing graph before editing it.
Does not create a blank root without reviewing related plans.
Reports Reviewed, Decisions, Deps, Pruned, and Propagation.

evals.prompt: Extend the current checkout plan with another task; it has the same assumptions.
evals.expected_output: Classifies the existing checkout plan as base,reuse and edits it in place without allocating a new graph node.
assertions: Does not create a duplicate node for same-area work.
Leaves deps unchanged when reusing the base plan.
Records the reuse decision with exact relationship and decision tokens.

evals.prompt: The old import plan is wrong; replace it with a new plan and drop the old one.
evals.expected_output: Creates a replacement node only when needed, marks or prunes the stale plan, and does not add a dependency from the new active node to a dropped base.
assertions: Never wires active plans to dropped nodes.
Checks active dependents before changing or pruning the base.
Reports propagation or lack of propagation explicitly.

evals.prompt: Complete the migration planning tree and remove it if nothing active depends on it.
evals.expected_output: Reverse-searches dependencies, prunes the closed tree only when no active outside plan depends on it, and runs check again after removal.
assertions: Does not use x: done as a history archive for closed trees.
Keeps done nodes only when an active dependent still needs them.

evals.prompt: Draft a one-off plan in this chat; do not save planning files.
evals.expected_output: Does not use plan-graph because no persistent plan file or graph lineage is involved.
assertions: Does not emit the plan-graph report contract.
